map.约束带松紧度(一指法则)检验器 使用指南: Restraint Strap Tension (One-Finger Rule) Checker User Guide
map.逐项检查约束带松紧度是否合适，采用\"一指法则\"评估，确保安全有效约束。点击各: Check each restraint strap for suitable tension item by item using the one-finger rule, so the restraint is safe and effective. Click each item as you check it.
map.肢体约束后以一指（成人）可伸入为度，过紧改松。: After limb restraint, one finger (for adults) should still fit in; loosen it if it is too tight.
map.每班查末梢脉搏、皮温与颜色。: Check the distal pulse, skin temperature and colour every shift.
map.小儿用两指或按体重调整。: For children use two fingers or adjust by body weight.
map.复核一例上肢约束松紧: Review one case of upper-limb restraint tension
map.：输入可伸入一指、末梢红润，工具判合适并提示每班查循环，与规范一致。: Entering that one finger fits and the distal circulation is pink, the tool judges it suitable and prompts a per-shift circulation check, which matches the standard.
map.约束用具使用时长(松解周期)计算器: Restraint Device Usage Duration (Release Cycle) Calculator
map.吸痰压力(成人/儿童)安全范围查询器: Suction Pressure (Adult / Child) Safe Range Lookup
map.气管切开换药间隔(按分泌物)计算器: Tracheostomy Dressing Change Interval (By Secretion) Calculator
map.能替代每班评估吗？: Can it replace the per-shift evaluation?
map.不能，仅检验提示。: No, it is an indicative check only.
map.过紧表现？: What are the signs it is too tight?
map.发绀、肿胀、脉搏弱，立即松解。: Cyanosis, swelling and a weak pulse: release immediately.
map.一指法则适用所有人？: Does the one-finger rule apply to everyone?
map.成人参考，小儿或水肿者调整。: An adult reference; adjust for children or patients with oedema.
